title: Ox Passion Triple Mango Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Triple Mango is a tropical indulgence, layering the rich, pulpy sweetness of ripe Mangoes with subtler hints of juicy, sun-ripened fruity flavour. The inhale bursts with the smooth, nectar-like flavour of fresh mango, while the exhale brings a slightly tangy, rounded finish for a full-bodied and exotic fruit vape. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a smooth throat hit and vibrant, well-balanced flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
